text:
incident-bot: SEV2 Alert: p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Alert threshold breached at 2026-03-15T14:02:12Z :rotating_light:

kai (oncall): seeing p95 ~650ms, p99 ~2.3s across edge. Streaming sessions dropping mid-stream ~1-2% :frowning:

maria (eng-sre): confirmed. Dashboards -> https://grafana.internal/redwood/plt/streams?from=now-30m show sharp jump at 13:58. Cache miss rate for prefix-hash keyspace jumped from 2% -> 28%.

amar (eng-runtime): recent rollout of prefix-hash v3-salt went at 13:45. Could be related. I see a config flip in rollout-ops: `PREFIX_HASH_SALT=sha:20260315`

lex (prod-ops): Customer Ops note: SSOCorp reported streaming stalls and aborts right after 14:00. CS ticket #CS-8432. They're on a high-traffic plan.

kai (oncall): assigning — I'll take triage. @maria @amar please correlate traces and check if fallback routing fired.

maria (eng-sre): traces: `trace_id=3f2a...` show KV GET latency fine, but miss rate up due to different key derivation. Bumping `cache.miss_rate` from 0.02 -> 0.28 in 10m.

amar (eng-runtime): confirmed mismatch: new salt changes prefix encoding length for older warmed keys so lookups miss. Keys not invalidated but hashed differently.

kai (oncall): immediate mitigations? We need to stop customer-impact. Options: rollback salt, enable fallback cache route that uses legacy-hash, or route affected tenants to dedicated pool.

lex (prod-ops): can we hotpatch a compat layer that tries both hashes for lookups? Might be cheaper than full rollback.

amar (eng-runtime): hotpatch looks doable but touches hot path — risky at p99. Safer: toggle rollout to previous salt and start a cache re-warm. I'll prepare rollback PR.

maria (eng-sre): while rollback builds, we can enable temporary traffic shaping: divert 30% of traffic to fallback pool (prefetch-enabled) and throttle new streaming sessions to reduce miss pressure.

incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation sent to oncall@redwood (kai).

kai (oncall): doing rollback now. @amar please coordinate the flag flip. Plan: 1) set PREFIX_HASH_SALT -> `sha:20260201` 2) restart cache-workers in us-west-2 (rolling, 25% at a time) 3) run warmup job for hot prefixes.

amar (eng-runtime): rolling the salt back in k8s config: `kubectl set env deployment/cache-workers PREFIX_HASH_SALT=sha:20260201 -n us-west-2`

maria (eng-sre): I'll watch SLOs and cache miss rate. If we see >50% revert failures, we abort.

lex (prod-ops): CS updated SSOCorp: "we're investigating elevated latencies; will update in 30m". Erin monitoring the ticket.

erin (support): customer sent sample timestamps and spans. They reported timeouts at 14:01-14:07. I'll attach traces once we have a mitigation.

(10m pass)

maria (eng-sre): rollback env flip applied to 3/4 deployments. Miss rate started trending down from 28% -> 8% in 3m. p95 -> 210ms, p99 -> 720ms. Streaming error rate dropped to 0.4%.

kai (oncall): good. continue restarts. Now starting cache warmup for hot prefixes — script below.

amar (eng-runtime): warmup script (curl loop) — running as job: 
```
for k in $(cat hot_prefixes.txt); do
  curl -s -X POST https://cache-warmup.internal/warm -d "{"prefix":"$k"}" || echo "warm fail $k"
done
```

kai (oncall): started job. Watching customer metrics.

incident-bot: Auto-note: rollback completed at 2026-03-15T14:18:10Z. Root cause suspected: prefix-hash salt incompatibility with existing cache key population.

maria (eng-sre): Post-rollback p95 steady ~200ms, p99 ~650-800ms. Remaining elevated p99 due to ongoing background warmup and streaming socket retries.

lex (prod-ops): confirmed SSOCorp pinged back; they see normalized behavior since ~14:22. They requested timeline and RCA.

kai (oncall): quick postmortem items for now: (1) rollback to previous salt — done (2) schedule controlled rollout for salt changes with compatibility flag that does dual-lookup for 48h (3) add pre-rollout simulation job to estimate miss-rate delta (4) implement a safe hotpath fallback that tries legacy hash on miss (5) improve alerting to correlate salt flips with cache miss ramps.

amar (eng-runtime): I'll open PRs: `runtime#452` for dual-lookup shim, `infra#780` for rollout gating, and a warmup job `jobs#122` for simulated warm cache.

maria (eng-sre): follow-up items: run an offline replay against 7 days of prefixes to measure false-negative rate on new salt; add a dashboard that ties feature flags to cache health.

erin (support): I'll prepare customer-facing summary: short timeline, mitigation, ETA for full RCA.

kai (oncall): handoff: I'm paged for next 30m but @maria will be primary for follow-ups. Leaving channel now, handing to maria. :handshake: 

maria (eng-sre): taking over. Will consolidate logs and create incident ticket IN-2026-0315. Anyone add anything pls now.

lex (prod-ops): +1 on dual-lookup shim as short-term safety. Also recommend a preflight check in deploy pipeline to run a quick miss-rate diff on a sampled key set.

(End of thread)

— Action items (summarized):
- amar: PR runtime#452 (dual-lookup shim) — due EOD+2
- amar: deploy rollback audit & verify no stray configs — today
- maria: IN-2026-0315 with timeline and metrics — today
- maria: dashboard tying `PREFIX_HASH_*` flips to `cache.miss_rate` alerts — next week
- lex: CS summary to SSOCorp (#CS-8432) — 1h
- erin: attach customer traces and note for RCA — today

Links: Grafana: https://grafana.internal/redwood/plt/streams, Traces: https://jaeger.internal/trace/3f2a..., Deploy: https://deploy.internal/rollouts/6789

Reactions: :thumbsup: on rollback, :eyes: on warmup progress.
